source: tools/list at the commit deployed on 2026-11-06 (from the running image tag), run from source

tools.name: list_applications
tools.description: List a compact, paginated application index. Heavy fields are available only when requested with fields.

fields.description: Fields to include. id is always included; heavy fields are opt-in.

cursor.description: Application ID after which to continue

q.description: Case-insensitive substring match on company and role

tools.name: get_application
tools.description: Get a single application by ID

tools.name: create_application
tools.description: Create a new job application. Supports linking a Reactive Resume via resumeId.

jobUrl.description: URL to job listing or opportunity page

companySize.description: Company size bucket; null clears an unknown size

salaryBandMentioned.description: Whether the source explicitly mentions a salary band

triageQuality.description: Triage priority 1-5; null clears the assessment (distinct from rating)

triageReason.description: Evidence, fit, blockers, and next step for the triage decision

tools.name: update_application
tools.description: Update non-lifecycle application fields. Use record_application_event for status, stage, contact, follow-up, and submission changes.

jobUrl.description: URL to job listing or opportunity page

companySize.description: Company size bucket; null clears an unknown size

salaryBandMentioned.description: Whether the source explicitly mentions a salary band

triageQuality.description: Triage priority 1-5; null clears the assessment (distinct from rating)

triageReason.description: Evidence, fit, blockers, and next step for the triage decision

tools.name: archive_application
tools.description: Hide an application from the active workspace without changing its lifecycle status or stage. Repeated calls are idempotent.

archivedAt.description: Archive timestamp (ISO 8601); defaults to the current server time

tools.name: unarchive_application
tools.description: Restore an archived application to the active workspace without changing its lifecycle status or stage. Repeated calls are idempotent.

tools.name: delete_application
tools.description: Delete an application and its contacts, submissions, and timeline events

tools.name: record_application_submission
tools.description: Atomically preserve the exact submitted answers, required document versions, and application-integrity attestation; block duplicate/repeat/same-company conflicts unless a reasoned override applies; set the application to applied; append an event; and verify the stored package. Idempotency key and human review required.

idempotencyKey.description: Stable retry key for this submission

policy.description: Required object for new submissions: humanReviewed, identityConsistent, factsVerified, profileConsistencyStatus, optional confirmedNoAnswers and audited override reasons. Omitted, null, or malformed values reach adapter replay resolution; invalid policy on a new submission is rejected there.

tools.name: list_application_submissions
tools.description: List submission summaries for one application. Answers are excluded by default because they may contain sensitive personal data.

tools.name: get_application_submission
tools.description: Get one owner-scoped submission including its exact answers and submitted documents. Treat the response as sensitive.

tools.name: append_application_note
tools.description: Record an immutable note_added timeline event without changing the compact application summary.

occurredAt.description: Stable event timestamp required for idempotent retries

tools.name: record_application_event
tools.description: Atomically append a canonical immutable application event and update the current-state projection when the event changes lifecycle state. Metadata is a JSON object with event-specific keys: opportunity_discovered {channel?, nextAction?}; recruiter_contacted {contactId?, outcome?, nextAction?, channel?, followUpAt?, toStage?}; stage_changed {toStage: string, fromStage?, toStatus?}; interview_invited {contactId?, outcome?, nextAction?, interviewType?, scheduledAt?, durationMinutes?, followUpAt?, toStage?}; interview_scheduled {interviewType: string, scheduledAt: ISO 8601 date-time, contactId?, outcome?, nextAction?, durationMinutes?: integer 1..1440, toStage?}; interview_completed {contactId?, outcome?, nextAction?, interviewType?, followUpAt?, toStage?}; feedback_received {contactId?, outcome?, nextAction?, followUpAt?, toStage?}; follow_up_scheduled {followUpAt: ISO 8601 date-time, contactId?, nextAction?}; offer_received {contactId?, outcome?, nextAction?, followUpAt?}; application_rejected {contactId?, outcome?, reason?, fromStage?}; document_attached {documentId: string, documentType?}; note_added {note: string}. Unknown keys are rejected.

tools.name: list_application_events
tools.description: List an owner-scoped immutable application timeline with deterministic cursor pagination.

tools.name: list_application_activity
tools.description: List the authenticated owner's application activity across all applications with canonical filters and deterministic cursor pagination.

tools.name: get_interview_recall_package
tools.description: Return the job description, exact submitted answers, timeline, and submitted documents for interview preparation. Owner-scoped sensitive response.

tools.name: find_application_by_job_url
tools.description: Find an exact owner-scoped duplicate using a canonicalized job URL.

tools.name: upsert_application_by_job_url
tools.description: Create or update one opportunity using an exact canonical job URL, avoiding duplicate records.

companySize.description: Company size bucket; null clears an unknown size

salaryBandMentioned.description: Whether the source explicitly mentions a salary band

triageQuality.description: Triage priority 1-5; null clears the assessment (distinct from rating)

triageReason.description: Evidence, fit, blockers, and next step for the triage decision

tools.name: pipeline_healthcheck
tools.description: Return deterministic pipeline data-quality findings without modifying records.

tools.name: batch_upsert_applications
tools.description: Create or update multiple applications in one call. If an item has an 'id' it is updated; otherwise a new application is created. Supports linking a Reactive Resume via resumeId. Max 50 items per call.

companySize.description: Company size bucket; null clears an unknown size

salaryBandMentioned.description: Whether the source explicitly mentions a salary band

triageQuality.description: Triage priority 1-5; null clears the assessment (distinct from rating)

triageReason.description: Evidence, fit, blockers, and next step for the triage decision

items.description: Array of applications to create or update (max 50)

tools.name: batch_delete_applications
tools.description: Delete multiple applications and their contacts in one call. Max 50 IDs per call.

ids.description: Array of application IDs to delete (max 50)

tools.name: list_applications_filtered
tools.description: Run an advanced application query with status, rating, remote, sorting, contact, and field controls. Defaults to all fields, no contacts; use list_applications for a compact index.

search.description: Search in company, role, notes, jobDescription

sort.description: Sort field, prefix with - for descending. e.g. '-rating', 'company', '-salaryMax'

fields.description: Fields to include in response (id is always included). e.g. ['company','role','status','rating','notes','salaryMin','salaryMax']. Omit jobDescription to save ~30k tokens.

tools.name: create_contact
tools.description: Add a contact to an application

tools.name: batch_create_contacts
tools.description: Add multiple contacts to one application. Each contact is created independently, so valid contacts remain created if another item fails. Returns total, succeeded, failed, and one indexed result per contact. Max 50 contacts per call.

tools.name: update_contact
tools.description: Update a contact on an application

tools.name: delete_contact
tools.description: Delete a contact from an application

tools.name: list_documents
tools.description: List uploaded documents with optional application, lifecycle, submission, orphan, pagination, and field-selection filters.

tools.name: get_document
tools.description: Get a single document by ID

tools.name: upload_document_content
tools.description: Upload a document from base64 content. Supports PDF, JPEG, PNG, and WEBP files up to 10MB. Optionally links the uploaded document to applications owned by the authenticated user.

filename.description: Original filename to display, e.g. resume.pdf

mimeType.description: MIME type of the uploaded file

contentBase64.description: Raw file bytes encoded as standard base64

tools.name: download_document_content
tools.description: Download the binary content of a document. For files <=1MB the content is returned inline as base64. For larger files, a short-lived signed URL is returned instead when object storage is available (falls back to inline base64 otherwise).

tools.name: update_document_links
tools.description: Update which applications a document is linked to

tools.name: update_document_metadata
tools.description: Classify an owned document and update lifecycle metadata. Submitted document content remains immutable.

tools.name: delete_document
tools.description: Delete a document

tools.name: get_cv_profile
tools.description: Get the master CV profile for the authenticated user. Returns all experience entries, skill categories, projects, and education — use these IDs/names when calling generate_tailored_cv.

tools.name: upsert_cv_profile
tools.description: Create or update the master CV profile. This stores your base CV data that tailored CVs are generated from.

id.description: Unique identifier for this entry (e.g. company-date slug)

tools.name: generate_tailored_cv
tools.description: Generate a tailored CV PDF for a specific application. Selects experience entries and skill categories from the master CV profile, renders a PDF, and stores it as a document linked to the application. Requires a CV profile to exist first (use upsert_cv_profile).

applicationId.description: Application ID to generate CV for

profileOverride.description: Custom professional summary for this application (omit to use master)

experienceIds.description: Ordered list of experience entry IDs to include

skillCategories.description: Ordered list of skill category names to include
